fusions.name: Den-Breaker
fusions.desc: An overhead blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 18% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 25%).

fusions.name: Cuffing Sweep
fusions.desc: Cuffs everything in a cone 3 tiles long for 12 damage and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Boilerplate Hide
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathering Weight
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
